4: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectScore.add("RedirectAllMovesToUser",
5:   proc { |score, move, user, ai, battle|
6:     # Useless if there is no ally to redirect attacks from
7:     next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if user.battler.allAllies.length == 0
8:     # Prefer if ally is at low HP and user is at high HP
9:     if ai.trainer.has_skill_flag?("HPAware") && user.hp > user.totalhp * 2 / 3
10:       ai.each_ally(user.index) do |b, i|
11:         score += 10 if b.hp <= b.totalhp / 3
12:       end
13:     end
14:     next score
15:   }
16: )

22:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
23:     if target.opposes?(user)

25:       next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if target.battler.allAllies.length == 0
26:       # Useless if there is no ally to attack the spotlighted foe
27:       next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if user.battler.allAllies.length == 0
28:     end
29:     # Generaly don't prefer this move, as it's a waste of the user's turn
30:     next score - 20
31:   }

80: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveFailureCheck.add("CurseTargetOrLowerUserSpd1RaiseUserAtkDef1",
81:   proc { |move, user, ai, battle|
82:     next false if user.has_type?(:GHOST) ||
83:                   (move.rough_type == :GHOST && user.has_active_ability?([:LIBERO, :PROTEAN]))
84:     will_fail = true
85:     (move.move.statUp.length / 2).times do |i|
86:       next if !user.battler.pbCanRaiseStatStage?(move.move.statUp[i * 2], user.battler, move.move)
87:       will_fail = false
88:       break
89:     end
90:     (move.move.statDown.length / 2).times do |i|
91:       next if !user.battler.pbCanLowerStatStage?(move.move.statDown[i * 2], user.battler, move.move)
92:       will_fail = false
93:       break
94:     end
95:     next will_fail
96:   }
97: )

101:                   !(move.rough_type == :GHOST && user.has_active_ability?([:LIBERO, :PROTEAN]))

106: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectScore.add("CurseTargetOrLowerUserSpd1RaiseUserAtkDef1",
107:   proc { |score, move, user, ai, battle|
108:     next score if user.has_type?(:GHOST) ||
109:                   (move.rough_type == :GHOST && user.has_active_ability?([:LIBERO, :PROTEAN]))
110:     score = ai.get_score_for_target_stat_raise(score, user, move.move.statUp)
111:     next score if score == Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE
112:     next ai.get_score_for_target_stat_drop(score, user, move.move.statDown, false)
113:   }
114: )
115: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectAgainstTargetScore.add("CurseTargetOrLowerUserSpd1RaiseUserAtkDef1",
116:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
117:     next score if !user.has_type?(:GHOST) &&
118:                   !(move.rough_type == :GHOST && user.has_active_ability?([:LIBERO, :PROTEAN]))
119:     # Don't prefer if user will faint because of using this move
120:     if ai.trainer.has_skill_flag?("HPAware")
121:       next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if user.hp <= user.totalhp / 2
122:     end
123:     # Prefer early on
124:     score += 10 if user.turnCount < 2
125:     if ai.trainer.medium_skill?
126:       # Prefer if the user has no damaging moves
127:       score += 15 if !user.check_for_move { |m| m.damagingMove? }
128:       # Prefer if the target can't switch out to remove its curse
129:       score += 10 if !battle.pbCanChooseNonActive?(target.index)
130:     end
131:     if ai.trainer.high_skill?
132:       # Prefer if user can stall while damage is dealt
133:       if user.check_for_move { |m| m.is_a?(Battle::Move::ProtectMove) }
134:         score += 5
135:       end
136:     end
137:     next score
138:   }
139: )

144: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectAgainstTargetScore.add("EffectDependsOnEnvironment",
145:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
146:     # Determine this move's effect
147:     move.move.pbOnStartUse(user.battler, [target.battler])
148:     function_code = nil
149:     case move.move.secretPower
150:     when 2
151:       function_code = "SleepTarget"
152:     when 10
153:       function_code = "BurnTarget"
154:     when 0, 1
155:       function_code = "ParalyzeTarget"
156:     when 9
157:       function_code = "FreezeTarget"
158:     when 7, 11, 13
159:       function_code = "FlinchTarget"
160:     else
161:       stat_lowered = nil
162:       case move.move.secretPower
163:       when 5
164:         function_code = :ATTACK
165:       when 14
166:         function_code = :DEFENSE
167:       when 3
168:         function_code = :SPECIAL_ATTACK
169:       when 4, 6, 12
170:         function_code = :SPEED
171:       when 8
172:         function_code = :ACCURACY
173:       end
174:       next ai.get_score_for_target_stat_drop(score, target, [stat_lowered, 1]) if stat_lowered
175:     end
176:     if function_code
177:       next Battle::AI::Handlers.apply_move_effect_against_target_score(function_code,
178:          score, move, user, target, ai, battle)
179:     end
180:     next score
181:   }
182: )

260: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectScore.add("CounterPhysicalDamage",
261:   proc { |score, move, user, ai, battle|
262:     has_physical_move = false
263:     ai.each_foe_battler(user.side) do |b, i|
264:       next if !b.can_attack?
265:       next if !b.check_for_move { |m| m.physicalMove?(m.type) &&
266:                                       (user.effects[PBEffects::Substitute] == 0 ||
267:                                        m.ignoresSubstitute?(b.battler)) }
268:       has_physical_move = true
269:       # Prefer if foe has a higher Attack than Special Attack
270:       score += 5 if b.rough_stat(:ATTACK) > b.rough_stat(:SPECIAL_ATTACK)
271:       # Prefer if the last move the foe used was physical
272:       if ai.trainer.medium_skill? && b.battler.lastMoveUsed
273:         score += 8 if GameData::Move.try_get(b.battler.lastMoveUsed)&.physical?
274:       end
275:       # Prefer if the foe is taunted into using a damaging move
276:       score += 5 if b.effects[PBEffects::Taunt] > 0
277:     end
278:     # Useless if no foes have a physical move to counter
279:     next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if !has_physical_move
280:     next score
281:   }
282: )
